title: Ultimate Nations
description:
A mod adding missile and more and other stuff: mod only on Fabric 1.21.8
 autor : ArtrixX and volume111
body:
the mod Ultimate Nations add some missile for your world and play war with your friends.
In this mod you have 10 missiles : tier 1 to tier10. This missiles can be crafted with uranite a new materials in caves. You can craft titanium to. It's an iron upgrades which is super resistant and can also be used to craft missiles.With titanium, you can craft items like the metal detector (it gives you all the ores in a 6x6 square below layer zero) or the chainsaw (one shots wood blocks)You can also craft a whole set of armor as well as the tools. There you go, for this incredible mod to play with friends!
